prompt.project_info: Radiant four-panel fashion editorial collage inspired by warm sunlight and vintage film, with consistent color grading across all frames.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long loose natural waves, fresh skin, sun-kissed glow and a confident radiant mood, wearing a butter-yellow or champagne satin slip dress.
prompt.composition_elements: Four clean square panels. Panel 1: full body walking forward with dress flowing and soft fabric motion blur. Panel 2: three-quarter body standing tall with hands on waist and sharp focus. Panel 3: half body turning head over shoulder with soft smile and gentle hair motion blur. Panel 4: detail close-up of hands lifting the dress hem slightly, emphasizing satin folds, highlights and luxury texture. Use a minimal beige studio wall or sunlit balcony with no props.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour cinematic lighting with backlit rim light, warm side sunlight, soft glow and honey highlights, soft shadows and glowing natural skin tones.
prompt.technical_specs: Analog fashion editorial, 50mm lens at f/1.8, selective clarity, film grain, halation, subtle bloom, slight vignette, medium-low filmic contrast, 1:1 four-panel grid.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a radiant fashion editorial collage inspired by warm sunlight and vintage film. Show one original approved adult woman with long loose natural waves, fresh skin, sun-kissed glow and a confident radiant mood, wearing a butter-yellow or champagne satin slip dress with flowing fabric and elegant reflective silk texture. Use a minimal beige studio wall or sunlit balcony, soft shadows, clean background and no props. Arrange four clean panels in a grid with consistent color grading. Panel 1: full body walking forward, dress flowing with motion and soft fabric movement blur, backlit golden-hour rim light. Panel 2: three-quarter body standing tall with hands on waist, still and sharp focus on face, warm side sunlight. Panel 3: half body turning head over shoulder with a soft smile, gentle motion blur in hair and soft glow. Panel 4: detail close-up of hands lifting the dress hem slightly, emphasizing fabric folds, highlights and luxury texture with highlight bloom. Use analog fashion editorial photography, 50mm lens at f/1.8, soft focus with selective clarity, film grain, halation, subtle bloom, natural imperfections, warm honey highlights, soft shadows, medium-low filmic contrast, slight vignette and 1:1 square grid composition.
